name: 卷毛鸭
evolution: 草头鸭 → 卷毛鸭 Lv.40
description: 身形与洛克近似，空洞的目光仿佛若有所思。头顶的毛发十分柔软，自然卷曲，这在鸭精灵中十分少见。
descriptionEn: Its body resembles Roco, and its vacant gaze seems deep in thought. The hair on its head is very soft and naturally curly, which is quite rare among duck spirits.
